notes: Control item: no findings. MUST 4 is a requirement for tests rather than behaviour; mapped to the tests it names. The palette-side parts of MUST 1 (debounce, Searching notes state, not holding other groups back) and MUST 2 (read-only tab, copy-path fallback) are checked only by Playwright; Vitest covers the host side. No test checks the copy-path fallback or that a note is never written. analytics.test.ts uses top-level it() with no describe.
